name: Dots
desc: A ChatGPT agent that keeps running in the cloud after you leave.
desc_zh: 关掉标签页也在云端继续跑的智能体。
solves: You close the tab and the work stops. A dot keeps going in its own cloud, so a long job survives you stepping away.
solves_zh: 你一关标签页，活就停了。dot 在自己的云端继续跑，长任务不会因为你走开而中断。
best_for: When a job takes hours and you would otherwise have to sit and watch the chat.
best_for_zh: 当一件事要跑上几小时，而你并不想一直守着对话框等它。
notes: 集成在 ChatGPT 内的能力。来源：https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-takes-meta-with-always-on-dots-agent-enterprise-ai-push-2026-09-29
